bias.zh: 偏空 · 跌破 $1,401 支撑

read.en: SanDisk slipped 0.6% on Oct 15 to $1,394.83 on heavy volume, recovering from an intraday low of $1,276.07. It is below its 5-day ($1,469.9), 10-day ($1,573.6), falling 30-day ($1,661.3) and 100-day ($1,647.3) averages and above the 200-day ($1,205.4). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2 and is below zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 6 ($1,719.1), and RSI is 34.
read.zh: 闪迪 10月15日放量下跌 0.6%，收于 $1,394.83，盘中一度跌至 $1,276.07 后回升。股价位于 5 日（$1,469.9）、10 日（$1,573.6）、下行的 30 日（$1,661.3）和 100 日均线（$1,647.3）下方，并在 200 日均线（$1,205.4）上方。MACD 自 10月2日起位于信号线下方并在零轴之下，抛物线 SAR 自 10月6日起看空（$1,719.1），RSI 为 34。

read.en: The $1,401 support (Oct 13 and 14 lows) broke on the close and is now first resistance, then $1,470 (former floor, 5-day average) and $1,574 (10-day). The day's low undercut the $1,325 Jul 17 low before rebounding. Support is $1,325, then $1,276 (Oct 15 low) and $1,205 (200-day average). A close below $1,276 would open $1,205; a close above $1,401 would target $1,470.
read.zh: $1,401 支撑（10月13日及14日低点）收盘失守，现为第一阻力，其次 $1,470（原底部、5 日均线）和 $1,574（10 日均线）。当日低点跌破 $1,325 的 7月17日低点后反弹。支撑为 $1,325，其次 $1,276（10月15日低点）和 $1,205（200 日均线）。若收盘跌破 $1,276，下一目标看 $1,205；收盘站上 $1,401 则目标看 $1,470。

r.en: Oct 13 and Oct 14 lows ($1,401–1,402), now resistance
